title: Back care flow
steps: Move through the poses in the order listed, one side at a time where the pose is one-sided.
Hold each pose for the time given and keep your breathing even.
Go through the whole flow twice. The first time is your warm-up, so keep it easy.
Finish in the last pose for a few slow breaths.
mistakes: Pushing into a pose further than is comfortable.
Holding your breath in the harder poses.
